Flow: Home/Electrical share live state. History owns range queries, reads saved SQLite via native/HTTP and remains usable disconnected.
Physical boundary: UI/platform adapters: user-interface/; BLE/decoding: device-interface/; capture: data-capture/; SQLite: local-storage/.
Native integration routes reads directly to Local data store. Receiver writes pass through Data capture; history needs no Bluetooth.
Rust composition lives in native-integration/. Latest/history read storage directly; Connect assembles Device Interface → capture → storage.
Both external paths preserve packet receipt time. Starter amperage and charge are unavailable; stale readings are hidden on both screens.
Not implemented: account/sign-in screens; media/manual/voice entry; route capture/sharing; engine integration; maintenance recording.
Zoom: local source after TestFlight build 7; new delivery and phone gesture acceptance pending. Android replacement remains deferred.
Confirmed 2027 beta structured store: SQLite via bundled Rust rusqlite. UI preferences remain in AsyncStorage; broader storage APIs remain unfinished.
